SPECIFICATION FOR 
SWIVEL HEAD NUT FOR SCREW 
TYPE MOUNTS IN PUSHER LEGS 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions and other requirements for swivel head nut used with screw type 
mount in pusher legs conforming to IS : 9419-1980 'Specification for pusher legs'. 

2. Dimensions 

2.1 The dimensions for swivel head nut shall be as shown in Fig. 1 . 

2.2 The thread dimensions shall be according to IS: 4218 (Parti to6)-1976 'ISO metric screw 
threads', and the screw threads of the nut shall have 6H tolerance class.

FIG. 1 DIMENSIONS FOR SWIVEL HEAD NUT 

3. Material —Shall he of designation 35 Mn2Mo28 according to Schedule IV of IS : 1570-1961 
'Schedules for wrought steels for general engineering purpose', or alternatively it shall be manufactured 
from designation 20C8 or 40C8 according to IS: 1570 (Part2)-1979 Schedule for wrought steels: 
Part 2 Carbon steels ( unalloyed steels ) ( first revision ). 

4. Workmanship — The nuts shall be free from burrs, cracks seams or other manufacturing defects. 

5. Designation —A swivel head nut conforming to the requirements of this standard shall be 
designated as : 

Swivel Head Nut M52 IS : 10749 

6. Packing — Nuts shall be greased and suitably packed, so as to avoid damage during transit. 

7. Marking — Nuts shall be stamped with manufacturer's name, initials or trade-mark and thread size. 
7.1 ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 


This type of swivel head nut is used with screw type mount 'A' in pusher legs conforming to 
IS : 9419-1980 as a mounting attachment for the rock drills with pusher legs. 


This specification has been prepared, based on the details supplied by the leading manufacturers 
of this product.
